report.source_text: MRI of the left scapula revealed a hyperintense lesion (12×1.7×12 cm) on the left paravertebral region extending from D5 to D12, which is suppressed on STIR sequence (figure 1). The lesion was also extending into the fifth intervening intercostal space, causing its widening due to mass effect. Visualised vertebral bodies showed normal signal intensity and morphology. The final impression of MRI was lipoma.
